o.text:
From Old Anatolian Turkish [script needed] (taš-baqa), equivalent to daş (“stone”) + bağa (“turtle; earlier: frog”).
Cognates
Cognate with Turkish tosbağa, Chagatai [script needed] (taš-baqa),Uzbek toshbaqa, Bashkir ташбаҡа (taşbaqa), Kazakh тасбақа (tasbaqa), Tatar, Kyrgyz ташбака (taşbaka), Uzbek toshbaqa, Uyghur تاشپاقا (tashpaqa, “turtle, tortoise”).
Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish نیکبین (nīkbīn) which is a pseudo-loan from Persian نیک + بین.
From Classical Persian خایه گینه (xâya gina, “a kind of scrambled eggs”).
Borrowed from Russian аэроклиматология (aeroklimatologija). By surface analysis, aero- + klimatologiya.
